```{r}
dat <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-13/frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv')
```
Which countries host the highest numbers of native frog/toad species?

```{r}
table(dat$isocc)

dat$isocc

countries <- sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(dat$isocc, split = ','))))
countries <- countries[countries !=""]

countries

grep('AD', dat$isocc)

counts <- sapply(countries, function(iso){length(grep(iso, dat$isocc))})


barplot(counts, las = 2)

library(ggplot2)

world_map <- map_data("world")
ggplot(data = world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon(fill = "gray",  color = "white")


```
